uncertain.note: sic: the print sets 'Preniierement' for 'Premierement'. At 8x the group after 'Pre' is a two-legged n with a clear top arch, then two dotted i's; not an m. Wrong sort, transcribed as printed.

uncertain.text: Cuerre leur frere, & mari de ladite de
uncertain.note: sic: 'Cuerre' for 'Guerre'. At 6x the capital is a plain C with no bar or spur. Wrong sort, transcribed as printed.

uncertain.text: ont dõnce deux des beaux-freres dudit
uncertain.note: sic: 'dõnce' for 'dõnee'. At 10x the first of the two final round letters has an open counter and no crossbar (c); the second has a full crossbar (e). Wrong sort, transcribed as printed.

uncertain.text: prouuer vnc ehoſe, en laquelle la foy des parens ſeroit
uncertain.note: sic, ESCALATE: the print reads 'vnc ehoſe' where sense wants 'vne choſe' — the c and e look transposed across the word space. At 12x with contrast the letter closing 'vn' has no crossbar (c) and the letter opening 'ehoſe' has a full crossbar (e); the word space between them is clear. Transcribed as printed; a human should confirm on the original.

uncertain.text: roit aux parẽs & ne nuiroit à perſonne: comme quand
uncertain.note: a small raised wedge sits between 'comme' and 'quand' (body-6.jpg x~1330, y~500), at apostrophe height, not on the baseline. Read as an ink speck or stray sort and not transcribed; it could also be a printed apostrophe.

the mark between 'l' and 'parentes' (margin-2.jpg x~400, y~1085) is a small blob at ascender height, far above the baseline periods of the same note; read as a period after the abbreviation 'l.', but notes b and c print 'l etiam' with no point, so 'l parentes.' is possible.

the last letter of 'alleguéz' is small and blurred at the resolution of the margin strip (margin-3.jpg x~500, y~575); read as italic z on sense ('pre-alleguez'), but an italic ſ/s cannot be ruled out.
